question: Padma Shri 2022 awardee para-javelin thrower Sumit Antil belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sumit Antil hails from the Sonipat district in Haryana, India.
 
• He is a celebrated para-javelin thrower who secured the gold medal in the F64 category at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
 
• Sumit Antil was awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in 2022 for his outstanding contributions to sports.
 
• He set a new world record in the F64 category at the Tokyo Paralympics with a throw of 68.55 meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paralympics:**

 
 
• The Paralympic Games are a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with a range of disabilities.
 
• They are governed by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC).
 
• The Paralympics are held shortly after the Olympic Games in the same host city.
 
 
 
• **F64 Category:**
 
 
• This category is for athletes with a leg amputation who compete with a prosthesis in a standing position.
 
• It is part of the classification system that ensures fair competition among athletes with different types of disabilities.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• Instituted in 1954, the Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• They are awarded in various disciplines/fields of activities like arts, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature, and education, sports, etc.
 
• The awards are announced annually on the occasion of Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw:**
 
 
• It is a track and field event where the javelin, a spear about 2.5 meters in length, is thrown.
 
• The objective is to throw it as far as possible.
 
• Competitors take a run-up before throwing the javelin to gain momentum.
